== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Communication constructs are specialized tools used to transmit messages and thoughts over distances. They function by projecting words or mental impressions directly into the minds of recipients, sometimes even reaching a person's soul. While some versions can facilitate instantaneous communication between different entities, others may have limited range and efficiency. These constructs are not simple or disposable items; they can be complex enough to possess a level of consciousness and personality, allowing them to speak or respond. They can be integrated into armor, used as standalone items in a pocket, or part of larger networks within structures like cloud fortresses. Users can activate them using [[madra]] to send specific commands or broadcast information, though some methods of transmission may inadvertently project images into the surrounding air for others to see.}}
